corrections.why: That text is a status note from the Eastern US Lookouts page, not an agency. The page names no managing agency.
The page says 'Standing, per Google earth of 4/4/2023'. The basis is 2023 imagery only, not a site visit.

notes_for_editor: The only page on this tower (Eastern US Lookouts) is one line: standing per Google Earth imagery dated 4/4/2023, in Wolfe County. The record's agency field holds that status text, so see the corrections. Two web searches found no tower history, and no build date, design, height or access is known. Source 2 (Wikipedia) supplies community background only; its own references were not checked. The status rests on imagery, not a site visit. Verification (2026-10-21): the entry sits under a 'Misc. Notes' heading on the source page and the page gives no structure type, so the story calls it a lookout rather than a fire tower.
